thread:
maria (CS): Hey team — Cobalt Bridge (account: cobalt-bridge) flagged an egress TLS/SNI requirement for EU peering. They need our proxy to allow SNI `api.cobalt-bridge.com` and outbound IPs CIDR 203.0.113.0/24. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-3291
liam (Infra): @maria got it — do they need mTLS with client certs or just SNI+IP allowlist?
diego (Eng): Quick FYI: if it's just SNI+CIDR we can add it to the edge ACLs and route to eu-edge. If mTLS is required we need a client cert, rotation plan, and a small infra change.
maria (CS): They said mTLS only for control plane; for inference traffic they want SNI and pinned egress to satisfy data jurisdiction. Also they flagged a renewal risk if this isn't in place before their trial end on 2025-03-12.
emily (Acct): Noted renewal risk — legal will ask about logs and key custody. We should confirm log retention and KMS posture before the renewal touchpoint.
liam (Infra): I can add a temporary allowlist entry for 203.0.113.0/24 and the SNI host. Ops: can we stage this in canary eu-edge first?
ops-bot: scheduled deploy: canary-eu-edge ACL update requested by liam — runbook step 1/3 — adding host `api.cobalt-bridge.com` and CIDR `203.0.113.0/24`. ETA ~15m :hammer_and_wrench:
maria (CS): Thanks — customer also requested a temporary QPS bump from 200 -> 800 for 72h to cover onboarding demos tomorrow. Cassio at Cobalt confirmed. I updated the ticket with the QPS window + revoke time.
liam (Infra): I'll add the rate-window and TTL in the ACL config. Example payload I'm going to apply:
```
{
  "cidr": "203.0.113.0/24",
  "sni": "api.cobalt-bridge.com",
  "qps": 800,
  "window": "2025-03-01T08:00Z/2025-03-04T08:00Z",
  "note": "temporary onboarding bump, autorevoke"
}
```
liam (Infra): Will post confirmation once canary passes. If there are KMS/legal asks, @diego please loop security.
diego (Eng): noted — if they want logs encrypted with a customer-managed key we'll need the SCC and contract language. pinged @security for checklist and next steps.
emily (Acct): I'll schedule a renewal checkpoint and collect their feedback about onboarding docs and the edge configuration UX.
maria (CS): Also asked by the customer for a low-level proof-of-routing screenshot after canary. @liam can you capture an edge trace or the specific request logs (no payloads) for them?
liam (Infra): yes — will grab the edge logs and a trace and attach to the ticket. Kicking the canary now.
ops-bot: canary deploy in progress...
ops-bot: canary deploy completed — 2/2 healthy, ACL applied. logs: https://logs.redwood.example/cobalt-bridge/1739998881
maria (CS): Awesome — sharing the confirmation and logs with the customer now. They said this materially reduces their renewal concern. :tada:
